senses.def: The station code of Byculla railway station in India.
buddy; male friend; member of one's friend group
man; dude, guy
so as to pass a given point
ex: every hour a train goes past

senses.def: in reserve; not for immediate use
ex: started setting aside money to buy a car
put something by for her old age

senses.def: Near or next to.
ex: The mailbox is by the bus stop.

senses.def: From one side of something to the other, passing close by; past.
ex: The stream runs by our back door.
He ran straight by me.

senses.def: Not later than (the given time); not later than the end of (the given time interval); before.
ex: Be back by ten o'clock!
We'll find someone by the end of March.

senses.def: After a given amount of time has elapsed or a given event has occurred.
ex: By February, we were all sick of the cold.
By the time I realized I had left my phone at home, I was already two blocks from work.

senses.def: Following a passive verb.
ex: The matter was decided by the chairman.
The boat was swamped by the water.

senses.def: Following a noun.
ex: There was a call by the unions for a 30% pay rise.

senses.def: Following an adjective.
ex: I was aghast by what I saw.
In other directions the fields and sky were so much of one colour by the snow that it was difficult in a hasty glance to tell whereabouts the horizon occurred […].

senses.def: Indicates the creator of a work: Existing through the authorship etc. of.
ex: There are many well-known plays by William Shakespeare

senses.def: Indicates a means of achieving something: Involving/using the means of.
ex: I'd know you anywhere by your gravelly voice.
I avoided the guards by moving only when they weren't looking.

senses.def: Indicates an authority according to which something is done.
ex: By the power vested in me, I now pronounce you man and wife.
I live by my own code of ethics.

senses.def: Invokes an authority in an oath.
ex: By Jove! I think she's got it!
By all that is holy, I'll put an end to this.

senses.def: Indicates a means of classification or organisation.
ex: I sorted the items by category.
Table 1 shows details of our employees broken down by sex and age.

senses.def: Indicates the amount of change, difference or discrepancy
ex: Our stock is up by ten percent.
We won by six goals to three.

senses.def: In the formulae X by X and by Xs, indicates a steady progression, one X after another.
ex: We went through the book page by page.
We crawled forward by inches.

senses.def: [with the] Acted on in units of the specified size or measure. (Sometimes hyperbolically)
ex: sold by the yard; cheaper if bought by the gross
While sitting listening to the radio by the hour, she can drink brandy by the bucketful!

senses.def: Per; with or in proportion to each.
ex: His health was deteriorating by the day.
The pickers are paid by the fortnight by the American bushel.

senses.def: Indicates a referenced source: According to.
ex: He cheated by his own admission.
By my reckoning, we should be nearly there.

senses.def: Used to separate dimensions when describing the size of something.
ex: It is easy to invert a 2-by-2 matrix.
The room was about 4 foot by 6 foot.

senses.def: Multiplied by or (chiefly South Asia) divided by.
Designates a horse's sire (“male parent”).
ex: She's a lovely little filly, by Big Lad, out of Damsel in Distress.

senses.def: At; with; among.
ex: Are you eating by Rabbi Fischer? (at the house of)
By Chabad, it's different.

senses.def: In a windward direction, sailing near to the direction from which the wind is blowing.
Along a path which runs past someone or something.
ex: I watched the parade as it passed by.

senses.def: In the vicinity, near.
ex: There was a shepherd close by.

senses.def: To or at a place, as a residence or place of business.
ex: I'll stop by on my way home from work.
We're right near the lifeguard station. Come by before you leave.

senses.def: Aside, away.
ex: The women spent much time after harvest putting jams by for winter and spring.

senses.def: Beyond or past a certain point.
ex: I'll somehow manage to get by.

senses.def: Out of the way, off to one side.
ex: a by path; a by room

senses.def: Subsidiary, incidental.
ex: by catch; a by issue

senses.def: A settlement in Norrköping municipality, Östergötland county, Sweden.
A settlement in Växjö municipality, Kronoberg county, Sweden.
